items.text: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho:
Anaor ji moa e pinje mamoko Babulon
mondo odhi opiedhe ka miudhwe kendo mondo oketh pinye;
ginikwede e yo mora amora e odiechienge
Kik jadir asere rid atungʼ mare,
ok ojwangʼgi Nyasachgi, Jehova Nyasaye Maratego,
gi ketho e nyim Jalno Maler mar Israel.
En kinde ma Jehova Nyasaye chuloe kuor;
Babulon ne en kikombe mar dhahabu
e lwet Jehova Nyasaye; nomiyo piny duto omer.
waweyeuru, kendo ngʼato ka ngʼato odhi e pinye owuon,
nimar osengʼadne bura mochopo e polo,
gima Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachwa osetimo.'
Jehova Nyasaye osethuwo ruodhi mag Media kodgi,
nikech chenro mare en ketho Babulon.
Jehova Nyasaye nochul kuor ni hekalu mare.
Tingʼuru banderane e ohinga mag Babulon!
ket jorito keregi, ikreuru mar monjogi!
Jehova Nyasaye nodhi nyime gi chenro mare,
buche moketo mondo otimre ni jo-Babulon.
Un joma odak machiegni gi pige mangʼeny
Adier anakelnu ji mangʼeny, ka bonyo,
kendo ginikog gi ilo nikech loch molowugo.
kendo oyaro polo gi ngʼeyo mare.
Ka omor ka polo, to pige manie polo wuo;
omiyo boche polo dhwolore koa e giko piny.
kendo okelo yamo koa e kuondege mag keno.
"Ji duto parogi ok ti kendo gionge ngʼeyo;
jotheth duto wigi kuot gi nyisechegi manono, ma githedho.
Kido mage moloso gin gik manono;
ka ndalogi mar ngʼado bura ochopo, to ginilal nono.
Jalno ma en Pok mar Jakobo
nimar en e Jachwech mar gik moko duto,
gira mar kedo, in ema atiekogo ogendini,
akonyora kodi kuom tieko faras gi jaithne,
in ema atiekogo gach lweny kod jariembe,
in ema anegogo dichwo gi dhako,
in ema anegogo jaduongʼ kod rawere,
in ema anegogo wuowi kod nyako,
in ema anegogo jakwath gi rombe,
in ema anegogo japur gi rwedhi,
in ema anegogo ruodhi gi jotelo."
Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, "E nyim wangʼu anachul Babulon kod jogo duto modak Babulon kuom gigo maricho magisetimo e Sayun."
anadhiru piny kua e geng got,
kendo ami ubed ka got mowangʼ."
"Onge lwanda mane kaw kuomi mar gero kona,
kata kidi moro amora mar keto mise,
Mini kod Ashkenaz mondo oked kode.
Yieruru jatend lweny mondo oked kode;
mondo oked kod ruodhi mag Medes,
kaachiel gi pinje duto ma gitelonegi.
Piny tetni kendo nigi rem mapek,
kuom Babulon osiko mondo piny Babulon odongʼ gunda,
gidongʼ e kuondegi mochiel motegno mag lweny.
machielo kendo jaote luwo bangʼ jaote machielo,
Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho:
"Mad masira ma gisekelonwa bed kuom Babulon."
"Mad rembwa bed ewi joma odak Babulon."
Emomiyo, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho:
"Ne, anabed jakori kendo anakonyi e bura;
anami nembe two kendo thidhna mage notwo.
kar dak ondiegi, gima bwogo ji,
Joge duto ruto ka sibuoche matindo,
eka ginindi nyaka chiengʼ ma ok ginichiew,"
gima lich makelo bwok e kind ogendini!
kama otwo kendo piny motimo ongoro,
kama onge ngʼama kalo e iye.
kendo anami ongʼog gima ne osemuonyo.
Kendo ohinga mar Babulon nogore piny.
Ringuru uaye mirima mager mar Jehova Nyasaye.
Kik chunyu jogi kata bedo maluor
ka wach mofwongʼ owinjore e piny;
wach mofwongʼ mar masira e piny,
kendo mar jatelo ma ok dwar,
Nimar adiera kinde biro ma anakum
kendo joge duto mosenegi nolware iye.
Eka polo gi piny kod gik moko duto manie igi
mosenegi e piny osepodho nikech Babulon.
Paruru Jehova Nyasaye e piny mabor,
nikech joma oa e pinje mamoko
osedonjo e kuonde maler mar od Jehova Nyasaye."
joma nigi adhonde nobed gi rem malit.
Kata ka Babulon ochopo e lwasi
Apaka mag wasigu nowuo ka pige mopongʼ;
machulo kuor ni ji kuom richogi;
Ruoth, ma nyinge en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho niya,
gininindi nyaka chiengʼ kendo ok ginichiew."
Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho:
kendo dhorangeye mage maboyo nomoke mach;
tich matek mar jotich en mana ramoki mach."
Ma e ote mane Jeremia janabi omiyo jatend jotije Seraya wuod Neria, ma wuod Maseya, kane odhi Babulon gi Zedekia ruodh Juda e higa mar angʼwen mar lochne.
Jeremia nondiko e kitabu kuom masiche duto mano bi kuom Babulon, mago duto mane osendiki kuom Babulon.
Nowachone Seraya, "Ka ichopo Babulon, ne ni isomo wechegi mondo owinji.
Eka iwachi ni, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, isewacho ni ibiro ketho kae, mondo omi dhano kata le kik dag e iye; enodongʼ gunda nyaka chiengʼ.
Ka itieko somo kitabuni, twe kidi kuome kendo idire Yufrate.
Eka iwachi ni, 'E kaka Babulon nonim ma ok nochak ochungʼ kendo nikech masira ma anakel kuome. Kendo joge nopodhi.' "
